coverage_decisions.decision: Use indicators, uneven development, Rostow and aid as coverage prompts. Correct HDI using UNDP: income is GNI and inequality is not a direct HDI component. Reject the idea that all countries follow one path or landlocked states cannot trade. Retain Ethiopia and Rosario rather than other-board case studies.
